rawFindings.title: Incorrect path construction in PostAsset.path virtual property
rawFindings.explanation: The change replaces pathFn.join(post.path, this.slug) with url.resolve(post.path, this.slug). url.resolve treats the first argument as a base URL and the second as a relative URL path and may strip or add slashes differently than path.join. This can cause unexpected path results, especially if post.path is not a full URL or doesn't end with a slash, changing the intended relative path behavior.
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert to using pathFn.join(post.path, this.slug) to correctly concatenate the filesystem paths as before.

rawFindings.title: Test case for handling asset with spaces removed
rawFindings.explanation: The test case that verifies correct handling of asset slugs and titles with spaces was removed. Since the new implementation uses url.resolve instead of path.join, URL encoding and path behavior may differ, potentially breaking support for assets with spaces in their slug. This test ensures such cases function as expected and should be retained or adapted.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the removed test case to verify assets with spaces are handled correctly, and adjust tests as necessary for the new path resolution logic.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect 'path' generation in PostAsset model causes wrong URL encoding behavior
rawFindings.explanation: The 'path' virtual property of PostAsset was changed from using path.join(post.path, this.slug) to url.resolve(post.path, this.slug). The former returns a path with literal characters (including spaces), matching the previous behavior and test expectations. The latter resolves URLs and percent-encodes spaces as %20, changing the URL style and breaking existing expectations and tests that expect spaces unescaped in the URL path.
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert line 21 back to using pathFn.join(post.path, this.slug) instead of url.resolve(post.path, this.slug) to preserve previous behavior and ensure consistency with tests and consumers.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect URL construction using url.resolve for PostAsset.path virtual field
rawFindings.explanation: The change replaces pathFn.join(post.path, this.slug) with url.resolve(post.path, this.slug). url.resolve treats the second argument as an absolute URL or path and may omit parts of the base URL, causing incorrect URL formation. The original use of path.join joined paths correctly preserving structure.
rawFindings.suggestion: Replace `return url.resolve(post.path, this.slug);` with the original `return pathFn.join(post.path, this.slug);` to ensure proper URL path joining.
